proposed_comments.title: Bound the graceful shutdown and report the actual result
Keep the detect condition in version space
proposed_comments.body:
Burn version variables are typed, so comparing them to an untyped `0.0.0.0` literal can fall back to string semantics. Prefixing the sentinel with `v` keeps the detect condition in version space and preserves the intended skip logic.

**Severity:** `high`

```suggestion
            <ExePackage DisplayName="Closing PowerToys application" Name="terminate_powertoys.cmd" Cache="remove" Compressed="yes" Id="TerminatePowerToys" SourceFile="terminate_powertoys.cmd" DetectCondition="DetectedPowerToysVersion = v0.0.0.0 AND DetectedPowerToysUserVersion = v0.0.0.0" Permanent="yes" PerMachine="$(var.PerMachineYesNo)" Vital="no">
```
